name: Qualtrics
summary: Qualtrics provides experience-management software for measuring and improving customer, employee, product, and brand experiences.
overview: Qualtrics returned to private ownership when Silver Lake and CPP Investments completed a 2023 acquisition. The transaction gives the company a clear take-private valuation and makes it a useful profile for private-equity-owned enterprise software.

facts.label: Take-private value
facts.note: Silver Lake and CPP Investments completed the acquisition in June 2023.

facts.label: Ownership
facts.note: Qualtrics became an independent private company after the transaction.

bull_case: Experience data can be deeply embedded in customer and employee workflows, giving Qualtrics recurring revenue and cross-sell opportunities.
bear_case: Survey and experience-management markets are competitive, while AI-enabled workflows and debt-funded acquisitions may complicate the return path.

intelligence.description: Qualtrics provides cloud software for collecting, analyzing, and acting on experience data from customers, employees, and products.
company: Qualtrics developed experience-management software used to collect feedback and analyze customer, employee, product, and brand experience data. The company was acquired by SAP, listed publicly, and then returned to private ownership.

Silver Lake and CPP Investments completed a $12.5 billion acquisition of Qualtrics in June 2023. The valuation is a transaction value, not a venture financing, and provides the latest clear ownership-change reference in its history.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Qualtrics is a large private-equity-owned enterprise-software company with a distinct round-trip through public markets. Its performance helps show how sponsors value recurring-revenue software once public-market multiples reset.

changed.text: Qualtrics lists publicly following its SAP spin-out.
Silver Lake and CPP Investments complete a $12.5B take-private acquisition.

takeaways: The $12.5B figure is an acquisition value, not a primary funding valuation.
Qualtrics is now a private-equity-owned enterprise-software platform.
Its public-to-private path makes it a useful software valuation case study.
Product differentiation and durable enterprise adoption matter more than survey volume alone.
